purpose: Require WDC to preserve the exact output of the same c64 control shape and the exact diverse single-user control outputs.
known_boundary: This backend is batch-shape-sensitive: the WDC-off control matched 38/64 sequential outputs with reorder on and 36/64 with reorder off. This campaign does not call that sequential-to-c64 boundary exact. It tests fresh-server determinism and candidate parity at the deployment shape.

gates.control_c64_replay: Fresh control matches all 64 retained c64-shaped token-ID digests.
gates.candidate_realistic: All 12 diverse 512-token responses exactly match the two-run current control oracle; workload/cache/kernel gates pass.
gates.candidate_c64: Both fresh candidate servers match all 64 c64-shaped control token-ID digests, cache counts are zero, collisions are zero, and WDC engagement is visible.
gates.performance: Candidate median c64 HTTP aggregate throughput is reported only if all exact-output gates pass.

publication_policy: A pass supports a c64 deployment-shape result with the batch-shape-sensitivity caveat. It does not make raw batched-bench speed or sequential-to-c64 equality a headline.
